title: Ned and the Big Oak
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: A wordless story about noticing change — a perfect chance to talk about weather words (windy, cloudy, rainy, sunny) together as you go through the pages.

pages.talk_prompt: It is a calm, sunny day by the big oak tree — what do you think might change?
pages.illustration: Ned the yellow duckling waddling across still green grass near a big oak tree under a calm blue sky.

pages.talk_prompt: The leaves are starting to move — what do you think Ned has noticed?
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling looking up at oak leaves beginning to swirl in a rising wind, grey clouds appearing at the edge of the sky.

pages.talk_prompt: The sky is getting darker and the wind is stronger — how do you think Ned feels now?
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling looking worried under a darkening sky, oak leaves and loose twigs blowing sideways around him.

pages.talk_prompt: Ned is hurrying towards the big oak tree — why do you think he is heading there?
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling scurrying fast towards the thick trunk of the big oak tree, wings half spread, wind blowing his feathers.

pages.talk_prompt: Ned has found a snug spot among the roots — what do you think the weather is doing outside now?
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling tucked safely among the thick roots of the big oak tree while rain falls heavily outside the shelter.

pages.talk_prompt: The rain has stopped and the sun is coming out — how do you think Ned feels now?
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling peeking out from the oak tree roots into bright sunshine breaking through the branches above, looking happy.
